entries.gloss: the law's witness to the maṣlaḥa: attested (iʿtibār), cancelled (ilghāʾ), or neither (irsāl, the maṣlaḥa mursala)

anchor.excerpt_ar: وهي ثلاثة أقسام: قسم شهد الشرع باعتبارها

entries.gloss: the rank of the maṣlaḥa: ḍarūrī, ḥājī or taḥsīnī; the unattested comes in these three kinds

anchor.excerpt_ar: وهذا على ثلاثة ضروب: أحدها: ما يقع في مرتبة الحاجات

entries.gloss: al-Ghazālī's certainty: the maṣlaḥa is known for certain (or by a ẓann near certainty), not merely probable, as the fortress is not
al-Ghazālī's universality: the maṣlaḥa concerns the whole community, not a limited number, as the ship does not

anchor.excerpt_ar: لأنها ليست كلية إذ يحصل بها هلاك عدد محصور

entries.gloss: the pinned position on the unattested ḍarūrī maṣlaḥa: the Rawḍa (not a proof), al-Ghazālī (only if certain and universal), Mālik as the Rawḍa reports him (a proof)

anchor.excerpt_ar: فذهب مالك، وبعض الشافعية إلى أن هذه المصلحة حجة

entries.gloss: what the first of two conflicting maṣāliḥ preserves: a ḍarūrī (by its kullī), a complement of the ḍarūrī, a ḥājī or a taḥsīnī

anchor.excerpt_ar: "و" تقدم "المقاصد الضرورية" الخمسة "على غيرها" من المقاصد.

entries.gloss: what the second of the two conflicting maṣāliḥ preserves, on the same scale as the first
the pinned position on dīn against the other ḍarūriyyāt: al-Kawkab's (dīn first) or the dissent he reports (the other four first)

anchor.excerpt_ar: وقيل: تقدم الأربع الأخر على الدينية؛ لأنها حق آدمي
